duties: Lead and allocate daily tasks to service engineers supporting installation, calibration, adjustment, repair, and optimization of lab systems, ensuring high responsiveness and efficiency.

duties: Lead end-to-end program execution for a complex Federal advanced wireless technology program, managing activities from planning and design through integration, testing, field demonstration, acceptance, and closeout.
Lead complex technology programs from laboratory proof of concept through systems integration, field deployment, testing, and operational demonstration.
Serve as the primary program integration point across AT&T, Government customers, technology suppliers, subcontractors, university/research partners, and internal engineering and operations teams.
Develop and manage the Integrated Master Schedule, contractual milestones, deliverables, critical-path activities, resources, and cross-team dependencies to maintain program performance.

Drive technical program integration across advanced wireless technologies, including 5G/6G, RAN, Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC), edge computing, APIs, security, spectrum, and laboratory and field environments.
Lead risk, issue, dependency, and change management, proactively identifying potential impacts and driving mitigation, corrective actions, escalation, and recovery plans.
Manage customer, supplier, and subcontractor performance, ensuring commitments, technical interfaces, deliverables, and acceptance requirements remain aligned with overall program objectives.
Monitor program financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, supplier commitments, resources, and the cost and schedule impacts of proposed changes.

Provide executive and customer-facing program leadership and reporting, translating complex technical, schedule, financial, and operational information into clear status, recommendations, decisions, and actions.

publishedPay.note: Employer-published range for listed locations; pay may vary by level or location.

duties: You will provide information to patients so they may fully utilize and benefit from the clinical service.
Processes incoming and outgoing calls/messages.
Performs patient intake, obtains necessary patient information to file and update patient records.
Ensures consents are reviewed and completed by clinician.
Performs pre-encounter prep prior to patients' visit, including identifying open care gaps.
Supports and demonstrates effective and professional communication with patients, family members, visitors, and colleagues.
Assists the clinician during medical treatments, examinations, and procedures.
Prepares patients for examination, performs and documents vital signs, and records patients' health history and medication reconciliation.
Performs duties and skills consistent with a trained Medical Assistant.
Prepares and sanitizes equipment, examination rooms and instruments.
Manages inventory of medical supplies and equips exam rooms with appropriate supplies.
Provides routine treatments and administers approved medication per clinician order within scope.
Assists the clinician by acting as a liaison on behalf of the patient to schedule appointments;
provides patient with scheduling information to obtain testing, and/or clinician consultation.
Maintains compliance with all policies and procedures.

duties: Serve as the primary point of contact between the community mental health center (Prepaid Inpatient Health Plans (PIHPs)) and members receiving behavioral health services, helping ensure timely access to care and continuity of services.

Support integrated, member-centered care that promotes improved health and well-being.
Provide telephonic and in person care management for members with behavioral health concerns.

publishedPay.text: salary range for this position is $116,000.00 - $174,000.00 / year
publishedPay.note: Employer-published range for listed locations; pay may vary by level or location.

duties: Manages accounts and partnerships with vendors by coordinating price negotiations for parts and services with Purchasing management;
reviewing contracts for purchasing and projects to ensure cost, scope, and terms of condition are acceptable with senior management;
Manages, protects, and improves Walmart assets by supporting the regional operations team during the home office budgeting development and approval process;
monitoring capital spending plans and expense budgets with maintenance operations;
developing annual overhaul and retrofit plans to return deteriorated and degraded facilities and equipment to acceptable operating condition;

Provides leadership to the regional operating team and developing and supporting ongoing initiatives by participating in annual meetings, travel, weekly calls, coordination of operational strategy, utilization of assets to support volume changes and forecasting, and establishment of standards;
developing and communicating key performance and financial indicators;
Provides support and direction for maintenance department operation in the logistics network which may include occasional travel by visiting distribution centers;

Ensures adherence to corporate policies in the area of distribution center (DC) maintenance management and compliance with regulatory policies and procedures (for example, OSHA, EPA, FSA, state and local authorities) by educating and training DC senior staff, maintenance associates, and regional operating teams on policies and procedures in the areas of corporate maintenance management, and regulatory compliance;

Develops new technology, processes, strategies and implements changes to improve throughput without impacting existing operations by managing facility and material handling projects to improve performance of the distribution network while limiting disruptions to operations and the distribution centers' (DC) ability to deliver freight to the stores;
developing relationships with Walmart members of cross-functional departments (for example, Construction, Insurance, Regional Operating teams) to ensure communication with DC Maintenance teams;

Develops skills and abilities of maintenance management and other maintenance associates to prepare them for promotional opportunities anticipated with the continued growth of the distribution center (DC) network by assessing needs and coordinating third party training activities in DCs designed to enhance maintenance department skills;
developing and recruiting maintenance management candidates to support the DC network requirements;

Oversees maintenance department daily operations by monitoring and driving department performance related to maintaining warehouse equipment (e.g., material handling equipment, pneumatic systems, electrical systems, air compressors, ammonia refrigeration equipment, general building repairs);
Drives the execution of multiple business plans and projects by identifying customer and operational needs;
developing and communicating business plans and priorities;
